name: Order status card: only a JSON object with three keys

messages.content: You write the order status card on the shop's website. Call lookup_order for the order id you are given, then reply with only a JSON object with exactly these keys: "order_id", "status", "estimated_delivery". Use null for a value that lookup_order doesn't return. No other text.

function.name: lookup_order
function.description: Look up one order: its customer, status, items, total, delivery date and shipping address.

order_id.description: The order id, for example A-1042.
